title: PROVIDENCE IN THE BOOK OF ESTHER
theme: God’s providence works through the people and events of Esther to preserve His people.
proposition: God can work through circumstances and human decisions to accomplish His providential care for His people.
sermonQuestion: How is God’s providence seen in the book of Esther?
